arxiv-2011-14236.title: A Smoluchowski-Kramers approximation for an infinite dimensional system with state-dependent damping
arxiv-2011-14236.creator: Sandra Cerrai, Guangyu Xi
arxiv-2011-14236.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Sandra Cerrai, Guangyu Xi. We study the validity of a Smoluchowski-Kramers approximation for a class of wave equations in a bounded domain of ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} subject to a state-dependent damping and perturbed by a multiplicative noise. We prove that in the small mass limit the solution converges to the solution of a stochastic quasilinear parabolic equation where a noise-induced extra drift is created.

arxiv-2103-12995.title: MANAS: Multi-Scale and Multi-Level Neural Architecture Search for Low-Dose CT Denoising
arxiv-2103-12995.creator: Zexin Lu, Wenjun Xia, Yongqiang Huang, Hongming Shan, Hu Chen, Jiliu Zhou, Yi Zhang
arxiv-2103-12995.description: Abstract Lowering the radiation dose in computed tomography (CT) can greatly reduce the potential risk to public health. However, the reconstructed images from the dose-reduced CT or low-dose CT (LDCT) suffer from severe noise, compromising the subsequent diagnosis and analysis.

arxiv-2107-07009.title: Free-Text Keystroke Dynamics for User Authentication
arxiv-2107-07009.creator: Jianwei Li Han-Chih Chang Mark Stamp
arxiv-2107-07009.description: Abstract In this research, we consider the problem of verifying user identity based on keystroke dynamics obtained from free-text. We employ a novel feature engineering method that generates image-like transition matrices. For this image-like feature, a convolution neural network (CNN) with cutout achieves the best results.

arxiv-2303-14483.description: Abstract With recent advances in sensing technologies, a myriad of spatio-temporal data has been generated and recorded in smart cities. arxiv-2405-08502.description: Abstract The SemEval task on Argument Reasoning in Civil Procedure is challenging in that it requires understanding legal concepts and inferring complex arguments. Currently, most Large Language Models (LLM) excelling in the legal realm are principally purposed for classification tasks, hence their reasoning rationale is subject to contention.

arxiv-2405-13029.title: Equations of motion for general nonholonomic systems from the d’Alembert principle via an algebraic method
arxiv-2405-13029.creator: F. Talamucci
arxiv-2405-13029.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by F. Talamucci. The aim of this study is to present an alternative way to deduce the equations of motion of general (i. also nonlinear) nonholonomic constrained systems starting from the d’Alembert principle and proceeding by an algebraic procedure. The two classical approaches in nonholonomic mechanics – C ˇ {\check{\rm C}} etaev method and vakonomic method – are treated on equal terms, avoiding integrations or other steps outside algebraic operations.

arxiv-2406-05951.title: Open-Vocabulary Part-Based Grasping
arxiv-2406-05951.creator: Tjeard van Oort, Dimity Miller, Will N. Browne, Nicolás Marticorena, Jesse Haviland, Niko Suenderhauf
arxiv-2406-05951.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tjeard van Oort, Dimity Miller, Will N. Browne, Nicolás Marticorena, Jesse Haviland, Niko Suenderhauf. Many robotic applications require to grasp objects not arbitrarily but at a very specific object part . This is especially important for manipulation tasks beyond simple pick-and-place scenarios or in robot-human interactions, such as object hand-overs. We propose AnyPart, a practical system that combines open-vocabulary object detection, open-vocabulary part segmentation and 6DOF grasp pose prediction to infer a grasp pose on a specific part of an object in 800 milliseconds.

arxiv-2412-03420.title: Automated Test-Case Generation for REST APIs Using Model Inference Search Heuristic
arxiv-2412-03420.creator: Clinton Cao, Annibale Panichella, Sicco Verwer
arxiv-2412-03420.description: Abstract The rising popularity of the microservice architectural style has led to a growing demand for automated testing approaches tailored to these systems. EvoMaster is a state-of-the-art tool that uses Evolutionary Algorithms (EAs) to automatically generate test cases for microservices’ REST APIs.

arxiv-2601-10938.title: Are Universal Potentials Ready for Alkali-Ion Battery Kinetics?
arxiv-2601-10938.creator: Xingyu Guo, Cheng Gui, Zhenbin Wang
arxiv-2601-10938.description: Abstract Accelerating alkali-ion battery discovery requires accurate modeling of atomic-scale kinetics, yet the reliability of universal machine learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) in capturing these high-energy landscapes remains uncertain. Here, we systematically benchmark state-of-the-art uMLIPs, including M3GNet, CHGNet, MACE, SevenNet, GRACE, and Orb, against DFT baselines for cathodes and solid electrolytes.
